name: Surface Pro 11 extras
summary: The Surface Pro 11's fixes and features while they make their way into Omarchy. Each package here either replaces Omarchy's package of the same name with a newer, patched one, or adds something Omarchy does not have yet.

packages.name: linux-omarchy
packages.description: Omarchy's 7.3 kernel with the Surface's suspend fix (the SAM link no longer drops when its UART powers down) and audio over DisplayPort.

packages.name: linux-omarchy-headers
packages.description: Headers for that kernel, for DKMS modules.

packages.name: surface-pro-11-support
packages.description: Speakers tuned the way Windows tunes them, the cameras, sensors and battery charge limit, the Flex Keyboard, and Slim Pen pairing.

packages.name: omarchy-surface-pro-11
packages.description: Sets the Surface up on first boot and pulls in the packages below.

packages.name: surface-pro-11-plugins
packages.description: Omarchy shell plugins: the monitor with automatic brightness, the battery charge limit, the lock screen with face unlock, and rounded corners for the Surface's rounded screen.

packages.name: surface-pro-11-face
packages.description: Face unlock with the IR camera: the camera setup facelock needs, and Face Unlock in Omarchy's settings.

packages.name: facelock
packages.description: Face recognition for login and the lock screen, newer than its last release so it supports the Surface's IR camera.

packages.name: surface-pro-11-windows
packages.description: A boot menu entry for Windows when it stays on the Surface, and Boot to Windows in Omarchy.

packages.name: surface-pro-11-keyring
packages.description: This repository's signing key, so pacman keeps trusting its updates.

packages.name: upower
packages.description: Arch's UPower with one patch: a udev rule can hide a power supply, so the Surface's battery, which two drivers expose, counts once.
